capabilities: Create toggle blocks with |> and <| syntax that render as a clickable triangle
Fold content scoped to a toggle when headers are placed inside it
Make code blocks collapsible using ```> fence syntax
Copy toggle content via a hover-revealed button on the title line
Animate triangle rotation and capsule rounding on fold and unfold
disambiguation: Not a settings or theme switcher; it adds foldable toggle blocks to notes.
extras: Called 'premium' in its name and description but the README shows no pricing or license details; the description notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Built on top of Obsidian's core folding engine, ensuring native performance and compatibility.
problem: Obsidian's native folding only works with headings and list items, so there is no Notion-style toggle block that folds arbitrary content under a clickable title.

relations.evidence: A premium, Notion-style toggle plugin for Obsidian.

summary: Notion-style toggle plugin that renders |> and ```> syntax as clickable collapsible blocks with animations and a hover copy button.
